zh_CN: 已保存。
en: Saved.

zh_CN: 去上班
en: Go to work

zh_CN: 住处
en: Apartment

zh_CN: 上班路上
en: On the way

zh_CN: E  关掉闹钟
en: E  Stop alarm

zh_CN: E  出门
en: E  Leave apartment

zh_CN: E  推开玻璃门
en: E  Push the glass door

zh_CN: E  买一瓶水 · 3 元
en: E  Buy water · 3 yuan

zh_CN: 闹钟在床头。移动鼠标环顾，W A S D 起身走动。
en: The alarm is on the bedside table. Look with the mouse; move with W A S D.

zh_CN: 公司账户失效了。打开工作台重新登记。
en: Your company account has expired. Open the workspace to register again.

zh_CN: 出门前，先在手机里完成公司登记。
en: Complete the company registration on your phone before leaving.

zh_CN: 登记完成。今天也要去上班。
en: Registration saved. Another morning at work.

zh_CN: 请填写有效姓名。
en: Please enter a valid name.

zh_CN: 这个生日日期不存在。
en: Please enter a real date of birth.

zh_CN: 剧情日期下，角色年龄须为 18—40 周岁。
en: The character must be 18–40 on the story date.

zh_CN: 请从现有外观预设中选择。
en: Please select a valid appearance preset.

zh_CN: 工作包在桌边。靠近后按 E 拿起，用 Tab 打开。
en: Your work bag is by the desk. Pick it up with E and open it with Tab.

zh_CN: 背包已背好。Tab 查看；点击选择；长按拖动，按 R 旋转。
en: Bag on your back. Tab to inspect; drag an item and press R to rotate.

zh_CN: 包里的电脑占了不少地方。选中它可以看看。
en: The laptop takes up a lot of space. Select it to inspect.

zh_CN: 长按物品开始拖动，拖动时按 R 旋转。整理好就可以关上背包。
en: Press R while holding an item to rotate it. Close the bag whenever ready.

zh_CN: 手机、电脑、钥匙和钱包都要带上。钥匙和钱包在门边柜上。
en: Bring your phone and laptop. Your keys and wallet are on the cabinet by the door.

zh_CN: 东西带齐了。门外是公共走廊。
en: You have everything. The communal corridor is outside.

zh_CN: 已经买过一瓶了。
en: You already bought a bottle.

zh_CN: 水瓶落进取货口，零钱少了三元。
en: A bottle drops into the tray. Three yuan spent.

zh_CN: 照片未能保存，或相册已满。
en: The photo could not be saved or the album is full.

zh_CN: 照片已存入相册。
en: Photo saved to the album.

zh_CN: 工作用笔记本电脑
en: Work laptop

zh_CN: 一台用了两年的高性能笔记本。金属外壳有细小划痕，边缘因经常拿取而发亮。
en: A two-year-old high-performance laptop. Fine scratches mark the metal shell; the edges are polished from handling.

zh_CN: 今天的表格和报告都在里面。每天背着它，分量已经很熟悉。
en: Today's spreadsheets and reports are on it. Its weight has become familiar.

zh_CN: 它还在包里。刚才明明只是去上班。
en: It is still in your bag. A moment ago you were only going to work.

zh_CN: 没有插座，也没有能用的网络。它仍很重，却是那个早晨留下的东西。
en: No socket and no useful network. Still heavy; still something from that morning.

zh_CN: 家门钥匙
en: Apartment keys

zh_CN: 两把磨亮的钥匙，挂着褪色的布绳。
en: Two worn keys on a faded fabric loop.

zh_CN: 旧钱包
en: Worn wallet

zh_CN: 棕色皮夹里放着通勤卡和一些零钱。折边已经变软。
en: A brown leather wallet holding a transit card and a little cash. The fold has softened with use.
